youtube.title: A Dead Man, a Secret Code, and Two Words | The Somerton Man
youtube.description:
December 1, 1948: a man was found dead on Somerton beach, Australia, with every label cut from his clothes and a scrap reading 'Tamám Shud' hidden in his pocket. The code in the matching book has never been cracked. In 2022, researchers named him as Carl Webb, a claim police have not confirmed.

📂 Case File #010: The Somerton Man
